reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Accurate plat map requirement and parcel descriptions
headings.reviewNote: Requires proprietors laying out a city, town, village, or addition to prepare an accurate map or plat describing public-use parcels and numbered sale lots with precise length and width.

headings.title: Street conformity, cemetery exception, and tax payment
headings.reviewNote: Requires streets of additions or plats, except cemetery plats, to run parallel with or continue existing municipal streets and mandates payment of all property taxes before platting.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text, cross-references (sections 528.270, 528.330, 528.550, 528.560, 473.533), and 1953-1974 case annotations; added the cemetery-plat exception to subsection 2.

headings.title: Plat book recording and official recorder certificate
headings.reviewNote: Directs the recorder to record delivered plats in a plat book, requires scale reduction when necessary to preserve uniformity, and prescribes the endorsed certificate wording.

headings.title: Certified plat copies as admissible court evidence
headings.reviewNote: Establishes plat book record copies properly certified under the recorder's hand and official seal as admissible evidence in all courts of justice.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text and revision history; corrected subsection 1 reviewNote to reflect mandatory ('shall') scale reduction when needed for uniformity and the statutory copy certificate form.

headings.title: Forfeiture penalty for pre-recording lot sales
headings.reviewNote: Imposes a forfeiture of up to $300 per lot on any person who sells or offers for sale a lot before the plat is made out, acknowledged, and recorded.

headings.title: Plats as conveyance vesting fee in municipal trust
headings.reviewNote: Provides that properly made, acknowledged, certified, and recorded plats vest the fee of dedicated public-use parcels in an incorporated city, town, or village in trust solely for those uses.

headings.title: Vesting fee in county trust for unincorporated areas
headings.reviewNote: Vests the fee of dedicated public-use parcels in the proper county in trust solely for those public uses when the town or village is unincorporated.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text and 1961-1967 case annotations regarding nonuser, vacation, and common-law dedication; retained all three drafted titles.

headings.title: Street board approval required in large cities
headings.reviewNote: Requires plans, plats, or replats of land within cities of 400,000 or more inhabitants to be submitted to and approved by the street-design board before recording.

headings.title: Prohibition against recording unapproved city plats
headings.reviewNote: Makes it unlawful to receive or record such plans in any public office unless endorsed or otherwise marked with the street board's approval.

headings.title: Dedication acceptance, maintenance disclaimer, and plan notice
headings.reviewNote: Deems street-board approval an acceptance of dedication without imposing city maintenance duties until actual appropriation, and charges owners and purchasers with notice of published board plans, maps, and reports.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text and revision history for cities of 400,000 or more; expanded subsection 3 title to include deemed notice of published street-board plans, maps, and reports.
